no_adcom_quote.quote: This product was not taken to an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee Meeting. The Office of Hematology and Oncology Drug Products has approved multiple other tyrosine kinase inhibitors (see background) using the same primary efficacy endpoint for use in the treatment of CML and with similar safety concerns.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BOSULIF (bosutinib, NDA203341). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) all state the product was not taken to an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because bosutinib was the third tyrosine kinase inhibitor in its class, approved using the same primary efficacy endpoint for CML with similar safety concerns. In lieu of an AC, the Division sought consultation from independent leukemia experts and a patient representative, but those clearances were still pending at the time of review finalization.
